steps.name: open general
afterLabels: Today's tasks, quadrants, habits and focus — four cards you can keep on your home screen.
Today's tasks · Quadrants · Today's habits · Today's focus
Touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen until the icons jiggle
Tap the “+” in the top-left corner
Search for “Heyta” and pick a size
The system does not let an app place a widget for you, so you add it once by hand.
If the card says “Open Heyta to show your widget” after adding it, opening Heyta once fills it in.
Credentials are kept in memory only and must be re-entered after the app fully exits.
This device remembers your choice, and it still applies after you reopen the app. Your home-screen widgets read the same preference.
Complaints and reports, Opens your mail app with a message to our intake mailbox

afterLabels: 今日任务、四象限、习惯、专注 —— 四张卡片可以把它们放在桌面上。
今日任务 · 四象限 · 今日习惯 · 今日专注
长按桌面空白处，直到图标开始抖动
系统不允许应用替你把小组件放上桌面，所以只能按下面的步骤自己加一次。
添加后如果卡片显示「打开 Heyta 以显示小组件」，打开一次 Heyta 就会填充内容。
凭据只保留在内存中，应用完全退出后需要重新输入。
这台设备会记住你的选择，重开应用仍然用它；系统小组件读同一份偏好。
投诉与举报, 打开邮件应用，把情况发到我们的受理邮箱
